chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: John Collins replaces Tiny Grimes
summary: Guitarist John Collins joined Tatum and Stewart after Grimes left and worked out much better.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: And like did you know John Collins, the guitarist John Collins?
Because he was with -- he was with -- at after Tiny had left, Johnny joined Tatum and myself.
Did you find that he worked, did he work out better in the band than Grimes did or --
Yes, he did. He worked out much better than Tiny did. Yeah, John was quite a guitarist.
Yeah, because I think it was -- I think I read where it was either Dizzy or Parker said that John Collins had helped -- had been one of the people who helped him get the new chords together --
